speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific nature of your double vision, such as whether it is horizontal or vertical, and when it started. Additionally, have you noticed any other symptoms like drooping eyelids or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The vertical double vision worsening with eye movement, combined with fatigable weakness that improves with rest, is highly characteristic of this condition. I will now request specific antibody testing and a chest X-ray to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Anti-AChR antibodies, Anti-MuSK antibodies. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
